items.title: How much does it cost to fix the same gap, depending on when it's caught?
items.description: Meridian's 30-minute threat-modeling session (2 engineers, roughly $50 of time) closed the exact same gap Halcyon's pentest found four months later at far higher cost — coordination, an emergency fix, and a customer conversation. Drag the stage where the gap gets caught to see the same underlying problem's cost swing by orders of magnitude depending purely on timing, not on how hard the fix itself turned out to be.

params.name: stageFound
params.label: Stage where the gap is caught (1 = design threat model, 2 = security testing / code review, 3 = production incident)
